effects.display_name: Player native equipment reach command requests
effects.actual_behavior: Ordered item chain: MAIN Spear of Paralysis, MAIN Visionary Spear, MAIN Crusher Claw, MAIN Abyss Atomiser, OFFHAND Temporospatial Transmitter, MAIN Infinite Torment. Thus earlier MAIN matches override the offhand transmitter. Each branch runs only when raw string arphex_reachmod1 differs from its profile, then requests actor-bound server attribute removals/additions and writes the profile regardless of command success or side. Modern entity_interaction_range additive deltas are paralysis1, vision4, crush2, infinite150; modern block_interaction_range deltas are crush2, atom2, spatial6. Profile transition removes the same fixed modifier ID on both modern attributes before its own additions; unused attributes remain removed. No match removes both modern attributes plus legacy aliases, writes none. Legacy forge:block_reach/entity_reach/attack_range requests use UUID/name/amount/add syntax; pinned Vanilla register instead accepts ResourceLocation id, numeric value and add_value, so legacy add syntax is not promoted as a second effective modifier or independent scalar. Slash-prefixed legacy attack removal and native command order are retained; legacy registry availability is not assumed. All requests bind @s to ticked Player and use one ID d08c99dd-c47a-4c6f-842f-084efe6ef91e. Native success is not inspected: the profile latch can prevent retry after a failed request, and missing/changed actual modifiers are not repaired here. Native range/command admission remains authoritative; no actual current attribute result is invented.

effects.display_name: Player raw floating latch movement and Elytra repair
effects.actual_behavior: allow_floatingsequence>0 decrements1 on entry, but writes40 at the end of every admitted callback: once positive, this root keeps it latched without an external clear. Independently fall-flying Living Player with vanilla Elytra in CHEST and current damage>0 requests stack damage=currentDamage-1 (no server check). ringspin reset360/decrement25 is particles only. Raw creativespectator clears abflymode, but ABFlight may still show particles; it later forces abflytime80. Ground OR lava OR water/rain/bubble OR occupied block at callback Y-1.5 OR Y-1 permits resource recovery: only ground clears abflymode; if time<80, nonnegative time gains2 without min-clamp (79 becomes81), negative time becomes0. Actual flight arm requires raw abflymode and time>0, without an item/status entitlement recheck. Fall-flying Player stops Elytra flight; server Living Player receives Speed10/1,false,false. Sprint writes absolute yaw-directed unit XZ while preserving Y; if no SHIFT and no SPACE, pitch>0 gives -pitch/75 else abs(pitch)/75 (native FLOAT division before double widening). SPACE: when slowcharge<1 add.05, with no post-add clamp; SHIFT writes Y0, else Y=slowcharge, then clears slowcharge2. Without SPACE, clears slowcharge; SHIFT subtracts.05 only when slowcharge2>-1, no post-subtract clamp, then writes Y=slowcharge2. Otherwise clears slowcharge2, and only nonsprinting bob: uplev true writes Y.02 when Y-1 empty else.04; uplev false writes Y-.02 only if all nine native floor probes empty, else.02. Nine probes repeat (+1,-1) and omit (-1,+1); preserve exact grid. XZ remain current for all vertical writes. Failed flight arm clears both charge fields. Afterward floatingsequence<=0 resets40 and toggles uplev; positive sequence decrements1. No hurt/addEffect success controls motion/repair. Native state setters/other item-key producers remain finite queue; ABFlight payload is reused and does not itself confer these raw flight permissions.
